neighbours.label: ' to' after 'need' in Indian exam, admission and job notices (candidates ... need to apply/check)
fire: All students who have cleared Class 10th need to collect their marksheets from the school office.
Aspirants who qualified in the prelims need to register for the mains exam before 15 March.
Candidates selected for the post of clerk need to report for document verification on Monday.
Those who have passed the CBSE board exam need to fill the admission form on the portal.
Students promoted to Class 12th need to deposit the fee before the last date.
Applicants shortlisted for the SSC interview need to bring two passport size photos.
Candidates who appeared in the JEE Main exam need to download the scorecard from the official website.
Freshers who have completed B.Com need to apply through the online recruitment portal.
quiet: All students who have cleared Class 10th can collect their marksheets from the school office.
Aspirants who qualified in the prelims are listed on the website from 15 March.
Candidates selected for the post of clerk will be posted to the district office.
Those who have passed the CBSE board exam celebrated with their families.
Students promoted to Class 12th received new textbooks last week.
Applicants shortlisted for the SSC interview were announced on Tuesday.
Candidates who appeared in the JEE Main exam found the paper moderately difficult.
Freshers who have completed B.Com are hired by many banks every year.
